Executive summary

This report consolidates 3 RUL experiment run(s) into one dissertation-style artefact. It combines aggregate metrics, model-level diagnostics, train/validation dynamics, held-out bearing predictions, residual analysis, execution logs, and full merged configuration for reproducibility.

  • Rank models by test behavior, not validation alone: validation RMSE selects checkpoints, but held-out bearing plots show whether that checkpoint generalizes.
  • Use multiple metrics: RMSE emphasizes large mistakes, MAE shows typical absolute error, R² shows explained variance, and PHM score captures the asymmetric cost profile used in bearing prognostics.
  • Check runtime and parameters: a lower RMSE is only compelling if its training time and model size are acceptable for the intended research comparison.

Ablation & configuration comparison

The ablation section is the report's high-level scoreboard. Results are aggregated across 3 run(s) by matching the stable run_id prefix before the seed suffix. That makes repeated seeds comparable without hiding model or dataset identity.

How to read this section. Each metric is plotted on its own axis so scale does not mislead the comparison. Error bars show seed-level standard deviation where repeated runs exist. The best run is highlighted according to the metric direction: lower for loss/RMSE/MAE and Liu paper PHM score, higher for R² and project PHM score.

Configuration

This merged YAML is the exact configuration used for the run: data setup, feature pipeline, model parameters, optimizer schedule, seed, and output paths.

data:
  dataset: phm2012
  root: ../data-bearing/ieee-phm-2012
  cache_dir: ../data-bearing/processed/phm2012
  window_length: 64
  stride_train: 1
  stride_eval: 32
  label_scheme: linear
  smoothing_alpha: 0.1
  n_bands: 5
  batch_size: 512
  num_workers: 8
  train_bearings:
  - '1_1'
  - '1_2'
  - '1_4'
  - '2_1'
  - '2_3'
  - '2_5'
  - '3_1'
  val_bearings:
  - '1_5'
  - '2_2'
  test_bearings:
  - '1_3'
  - '1_6'
  - '1_7'
  - '2_4'
  - '2_6'
  - '2_7'
  - '3_2'
  - '3_3'
model:
  name: vanilla_lstm_rul
  d_model: 128
  num_layers: 4
  bidirectional: false
  head_hidden: 128
  dropout: 0.2
train:
  max_epochs: 75
  lr: 0.0008
  weight_decay: 0.0003
  xlstm_lr_mult: 0.75
  freeze_xlstm_epochs: 5
  scheduler: cosine
  warmup_epochs: 5
  monotonicity_weight: 0.05
  gradient_clip_val: 1.0
  early_stopping_patience: 9999
  precision: bf16-mixed
  seed: 42
  results_root: results
  run_id: null

Configuration

This merged YAML is the exact configuration used for the run: data setup, feature pipeline, model parameters, optimizer schedule, seed, and output paths.

data:
  dataset: phm2012
  root: ../data-bearing/ieee-phm-2012
  cache_dir: ../data-bearing/processed/phm2012
  window_length: 64
  stride_train: 1
  stride_eval: 32
  label_scheme: linear
  smoothing_alpha: 0.1
  n_bands: 5
  batch_size: 512
  num_workers: 8
  train_bearings:
  - '1_1'
  - '1_2'
  - '1_4'
  - '2_1'
  - '2_3'
  - '2_5'
  - '3_1'
  val_bearings:
  - '1_5'
  - '2_2'
  test_bearings:
  - '1_3'
  - '1_6'
  - '1_7'
  - '2_4'
  - '2_6'
  - '2_7'
  - '3_2'
  - '3_3'
model:
  name: vanilla_transformer_rul
  d_model: 128
  n_heads: 8
  num_layers: 4
  ffn_dim: 768
  head_hidden: 128
  dropout: 0.2
  head_pool: mean
train:
  max_epochs: 75
  lr: 0.0008
  weight_decay: 0.0003
  xlstm_lr_mult: 0.75
  freeze_xlstm_epochs: 5
  scheduler: cosine
  warmup_epochs: 5
  monotonicity_weight: 0.05
  gradient_clip_val: 1.0
  early_stopping_patience: 9999
  precision: bf16-mixed
  seed: 42
  results_root: results
  run_id: null
